name: Augmented Reality Systems Engineer
description: Develop low-level systems for AR/VR headsets. Implement SLAM, hand tracking, display pipelines, and spatial audio.
example_snippet:
program ARPose:
    shape Pose holds:
        PositionX as fractional number
        PositionY as fractional number
        PositionZ as fractional number
        QuaternionW as fractional number
        QuaternionX as fractional number
        QuaternionY as fractional number
        QuaternionZ as fractional number
    end shape

    action update_pose takes P as ref Pose, AccelX as fractional number, 
                         AccelY as fractional number, AccelZ as fractional number, 
                         Dt as fractional number produces nothing:
        put the sum of P.PositionX and the product of AccelX and Dt into P.PositionX
        put the sum of P.PositionY and the product of AccelY and Dt into P.PositionY
        put the sum of P.PositionZ and the product of AccelZ and Dt into P.PositionZ
    end action

    keep CurrentPose as Pose with 0.0 and 0.0 and 0.0 and 1.0 and 0.0 and 0.0 and 0.0
    call update_pose with CurrentPose and 0.1 and 0.0 and 9.8 and 0.016
    print the text "Position: (" and CurrentPose.PositionX and ", " and CurrentPose.PositionY and ", " and CurrentPose.PositionZ and ")" and newline
end program
